gaps.expected: Payment allocates strictly to Previous Year Outstanding balance before current academic year bill.
gaps.actual: NPR 2,000 paid allocated NPR 2,000 to Previous Year Balance, leaving Current Bill UNPAID at NPR 4,000.
gaps.evidence: Live Firestore document transaction verified.

gaps.expected: Active advance credit is automatically consumed against new bill, reducing payable balance.
gaps.actual: NPR 1,500 advance credit applied to NPR 5,000 bill, net cash payable = NPR 3,500.
gaps.evidence: Live Firestore transaction & advance state update verified.

gaps.expected: Overpayment generates new active student advance credit document.
gaps.actual: NPR 5,000 paid on NPR 3,000 bill generated NPR 2,000 active advance document.
gaps.evidence: Live Firestore student_advances document creation verified.

gaps.expected: Reversal voids receipt, restores bill balance, and creates audit log.
gaps.actual: Payment reversed, receipt status set to VOID, bill outstanding restored to NPR 4,000, audit log created.
gaps.evidence: Live Firestore transaction reversal verified.

gaps.expected: Collection report accurately queries active non-voided transactions for date range.
gaps.actual: Queried transactions collection successfully, aggregating live paid totals while excluding VOID payments.
gaps.evidence: Live Firestore transactions collection aggregation verified.

gaps.expected: Outstanding report aggregates unpaid/partial bill balances, excluding paid bills.
gaps.actual: Queried remitBills collection, calculated net active outstanding across unpaid/partially paid bills.
gaps.evidence: Live Firestore remitBills collection aggregation verified.

gaps.expected: Scholarship report accurately queries students with assigned concessions.
gaps.actual: Queried students with scholarshipAmount > 0 cleanly from source student records.
gaps.evidence: Live Firestore students collection query verified.

gaps.expected: Advance report aggregates active student advance balances.
gaps.actual: Queried student_advances collection, aggregated active unconsumed credit.
gaps.evidence: Live Firestore student_advances collection query verified.

gaps.expected: Receipt register lists sequential RCP records from transactions collection.
gaps.actual: Queried transactions collection, verified receipt numbers sequential with zero collisions.
gaps.evidence: Live Firestore transactions sequence verification confirmed.

gaps.expected: System records immutable audit log entries with required WHO, WHAT, WHEN, WHY fields.
gaps.actual: Queried ledger_audit_logs collection, verified immutable schema compliance.
gaps.evidence: Live Firestore ledger_audit_logs collection verified.

gaps.expected: Admin possesses full operational access across fee management system.
gaps.actual: Executed full admin workflow successfully with complete Firestore updates.
gaps.evidence: Admin role permissions & workflow step execution verified.

gaps.expected: Student reads own financial info and is strictly BLOCKED from financial writes.
gaps.actual: Student read own bill successfully; unauthorized write thrown permission-denied.
gaps.evidence: Live Firestore evaluation under student auth context verified.

gaps.expected: Teacher is strictly BLOCKED from financial reads and writes.
gaps.actual: Teacher attempt to read remitBills thrown permission-denied.
gaps.evidence: Live Firestore evaluation under teacher auth context verified.

gaps.expected: Daily cash collection matches total physical cash collected in transactions.
gaps.actual: Queried daily cash collection against ledger totals, reconciliation verified.
gaps.evidence: Live Firestore cash reconciliation check verified.

gaps.expected: User authentication state and loaded financial records persist across real browser page.reload() and re-login across Admin, Student, and Teacher roles.
gaps.actual: Tested real page.reload() and re-login in Chromium for Admin (http://localhost:3000/fee-structure -> http://localhost:3000/fee-structure), Student (http://localhost:3000/ -> http://localhost:3000/), and Teacher. State and access restrictions persisted 100%.
gaps.evidence: Chromium page.reload() and authentication rehydration executed. Evidence screenshots: step4_browser_evidence/gap16_admin_after_reload.png, gap16_student_after_reload.png, gap16_teacher_after_reload.png.
